name: pell
desc: A town night-watchman in his forties working the day shift and unhappy about it: lean, long-jawed, close-cropped sandy hair going grey at the temples, a deadpan level stare, a small nick of an old scar on one eyebrow. He wears a sage-green wool watchcoat with a wide turned collar and a town badge at the breast, a leather belt of lamp tools, a short wick-knife sheathed at his hip, and carries a snuffed brass lantern hooked on his forearm. Precise, professional, faintly aggrieved.
sheetHint: lean and long-jawed, close-cropped sandy grey hair, sage-green wool watchcoat with town badge, belt of lamp tools, wick-knife at hip, brass lantern on forearm
